It fits seamlessly into your workflow through simplified access to your data. The innovative design of the CashPro App helps you find what you need quickly and efficiently, from approving high-value payments to checking credit balances. Bringing the power of digital and the convenience of mobile to cash management.

Bank of America was named “World’s Best Bank” and “World’s Best Bank in Payments and Treasury” by Euromoney Magazine in 2022. The CashPro App has been recognized as the best Mobile App in 2022 and has won many prestigious awards from Coalition Greenwich, Celent, Global Finance, and Treasury Management International.

With the app you can safely view and take action across several banking capabilities:
•	Securely access your account using biometric identification
•	Electronically view, receive, and sign documents
•	Quickly access CashPro on a web browser with QR Sign-In
•	View credit balances and loan history 
•	Monitor your account balances and activity 
•	Quickly and easily locate transactions 
•	Initiate and approve payments
•	Remotely deposit checks
•	Make Check Positive Pay decisions
•	Approve or reject incoming transaction requests via ACH Positive Pay
•	Activate a Mobile Token
•	Transfer a Mobile Token to a new device
•	Live chat with a CashPro expert 
•	Personalize your display settings with light mode and dark mode
•	Manage your CashPro Alerts
•	Receive notifications about critical transactions on your device
•	Monitor and manage user access 
•	Take convenient administrative actions
•	Access CashPro Help content
•	Add a CashPro App widget to your mobile device

It has never been easier to access your accounts and perform critical tasks. There are no additional fees or charges for the CashPro App*. To access the functionality of the app, your company’s CashPro administrator must permission you “Mobile Access”. 

The CashPro App and Mobile Tokens are supported everywhere. Download the app today and please leave a rating and review!

Requires Apple iOS version 12.4 or later.
